contexts.text: They cannot approach the first threshold of the court of the Heavens...
Such light of life is turned into mere darkness when they approach towards Heaven.

Evil Spirits cannot approach the sphere, or any Society, where there are good Spirits... when they only approach, they begin to be tortured... AC 2049:4. AC 4175:end. AC 4299:2. AC 4459:5, Explained. AC 4555.
Evil Spirits... are seized with terror at their first approach (to those who feel horror at evils and falsities).
The evil fear and feel horror at the Holy of the Lord, so that they cannot approach it...
When (adulterers) merely approach the heavenly Societies, they smell their own stench...
Not even the Angels can approach the Divine...
When they approach any heavenly Society, this lumen is extinguished... AC 4319:end. AC 4531.
When the outwardly sensual approach the inwardly sensual... they begin to breathe with difficulty...
The ideas of the natural man formed from the fallacies of the senses... cannot endure the approach (of good).
No others can approach (those who are in celestial love)...
Good acts through truth, for so it can approach (the evil).
As often as Spirits who had lived in these loves approached, my delight... vanished.
